fact: The Hauts Bassins regional yearbook 2023 (edition 2024, validated 15 October 2024) publishes marriages, births and deaths registered at civil status by commune, sourced from governorate and mairie records.
title: ANNUAIRE STATISTIQUE REGIONAL - Annuaire statistique 2023 de la région des Hauts Bassins
publisher: INSD, Direction régionale des Hauts Bassins
